{"metadata":{"description":"OLED burn-in care plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: true-black nap screensaver, pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware dimming, hue rotation","id":"gh:1340145656","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"OLEDCare","slug":"domparent/OLEDCare","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","oled"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OLED burn-in care plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: true-black nap screensaver, pure-black su"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rfaces, gamma-aware dimming, hue rotation"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# OLEDCare"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A DeepSeek Harness plugin (#dsh-plugin) that protects OLED panels during long agent sessions.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"OLED burn-in protection for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (`dsh web`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"OLED panels wear where pixels stay lit for hours — exactly what a long agent session does to backgro"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"unds, hairline borders, and bright text. OledCare pushes back on all three:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Nap mode** — a true-black (`#000`) full-screen screensaver, so every background pixel switches f"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ully off. It fades in smoothly after idle minutes (with an optional 30-second wind-down), or on dema"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nd from the **☾ Nap** button in the session header. A dim drifting clock (so the clock itself does n"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ot burn in) shows live agent status — *agent is working / waiting for your input / idle* — and any m"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ouse or key input wakes the screen.
- **Pure-black surfaces** — every dark-scheme background token g"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"oes to `#000000`; background pixels turn fully off instead of glowing dark gray.
- **Fainter static "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"borders** — hairline dividers sit at the same pixels all day, so their dark values go dimmer than th"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"e shipped palette.
- **Gamma-aware dimming** — white text and bright accent tokens are scaled as a l"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"inear-light luminance ratio, so perceived contrast between text shades is preserved while total ligh"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"t output drops.
- **Idle/focus ladder** — normal intensity → deep dim when idle or the window loses "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"focus → nap. Three rungs, each configurable.
- **Hue rotation** — the accent hue drifts through a ~1"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"2-hour cycle so static brand-colored icons wear every subpixel evenly."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) with the `web` profile (`dsh web`)
- pnpm on PATH (`dsh plug"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"(`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) with the `web` profile (`dsh web`)
- pnpm on PATH (`dsh plugin` forwards to it)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"From GitHub:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"From a local checkout:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` and reload the browser tab. Open **Settings → OLEDCare** in the settings left"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"restart `dsh web` and reload the browser tab. Open **Settings → OLEDCare** in the settings left nav."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"No build step runs on install: `client.js` ships in the harness browser-module format exactly as the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" browser loads it, so GitHub installs work without allowlisting a `prepare` script."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` afterwards."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Three presets — **Off**, **Balanced** (default: black surfaces, 85% text, nap at 10 min), **Maximum*"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"* (70% text, deep dim at 3 min, nap at 5 min) — plus a Custom state that appears when you tweak any "},{"id":"p21s3","text":" text, deep dim at 3 min, nap at 5 min) — plus a Custom state that appears when you tweak any field:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Field | What it does |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Pure black backgrounds | Every surface goes `#000`; background pixels turn fully off |
| Fainter s"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"tatic borders | Dims hairline borders beyond the shipped palette |
| Text/accent intensity | Linear-"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"light scaling of white text and bright accents |
| Hue rotation | ~12 h accent-hue cycle for even su"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"bpixel wear |
| Deep-dim after idle | Minutes without input before the deeper intensity applies |
| "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"Deep-dim intensity | The dimmer level used while idle or unfocused |
| Deep-dim when unfocused | App"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ly deep dim whenever the window loses focus |
| Auto nap after idle | Minutes without input before t"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"he nap screen engages |
| Gradual wind-down | Fades the screen to black over the 30 s before auto-na"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"en engages |
| Gradual wind-down | Fades the screen to black over the 30 s before auto-nap engages |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A diagnostics box at the bottom of the settings page shows the live token layer, the resolved body b"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ackground, the current dim rung, and the nap/idle state."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Settings persist in the browser's `localStorage` (key `dsh-oled-care:v1`), so your preset and custom"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" mix survive `dsh web` restarts. Where storage is unavailable (private windows, blocked storage), th"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"e plugin falls back to in-memory settings for the session."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- The package is a profile **bundle**: `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` points at `cordis.patch."},{"id":"p27s2","text":"yml`, which inserts one plugin row. The client module system scans the row's `dsh.client` declaratio"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"n into the browser roster and serves `client.js` at `/plugins/dsh-oled-care/client.js`.
- All visual"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" changes go through the client **theme service** as one replaceable token-override layer — the shipp"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ed theme is never edited, and removing the plugin restores it exactly.
- UI is composed through the "},{"id":"p27s6","text":"slot system only: `shell.overlay` (nap screen), `conversation.session.header.actions` (nap button), "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"and `settings.section` (settings page)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- The light color scheme is left essentially untouched — OLED care targets dark UIs.
- Developed aga"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"inst dsh `0.1.0-rc.x`. The browser module format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) is an internal har"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ness contract; pin your dsh version or check release notes when upgrading.
- No network calls, no te"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"lemetry, no access to conversation content. The only storage touched is `localStorage`, and only for"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" the plugin's own settings."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
